templates.name: Balanced Starter
templates.description: A simple starter agent that diversifies across strong stocks, buys dips, and takes profits after run-ups.
templates.author: Agentic Trading Lab

pipeline.label: Trading instruction
pipeline.prompt: Spread the money across a few of the strongest available stocks. Buy on meaningful dips, take profits after strong run-ups, and never put everything into one stock.

templates.name: Momentum Scout
templates.description: Focus on recent price strength and volume. Favor leaders with positive momentum and trim laggards quickly.
templates.author: Agentic Trading Lab

pipeline.label: Trading instruction
pipeline.prompt: Prioritize stocks showing the strongest recent momentum and healthy volume. Add to winners on pullbacks, cut positions that lose momentum, and keep cash when the tape is unclear.

templates.name: Pipeline Analyst
templates.description: A three-step strategy: gather market facts, convert them into signals, then produce executable orders.
templates.author: Agentic Trading Lab

pipeline.label: Information Gathering
pipeline.prompt: You are the information-gathering sub-agent. Collect key facts relevant to trading decisions from market data, news, and macro events. Filter noise and keep high-confidence facts and indicator changes.

pipeline.label: Information to Signal
pipeline.prompt: You are the signal-generation sub-agent. Based on upstream information-gathering output, convert facts and indicators into executable trading signals (direction, strength, time horizon).

pipeline.label: Signal to Execution
pipeline.prompt: You are the trade-execution sub-agent. Turn signals into concrete order instructions, respecting position limits, liquidity, and slippage. Output a submit-ready buy/sell plan.

templates.name: AI Hedge Fund
templates.description: A hosted panel of AI analysts that weigh in on every trade, run through Agentic Trading Lab's long-only backtest engine. Based on the open-source AI Hedge Fund project by virattt.
templates.author: virattt / Agentic Trading Lab

templates.name: Blue-Chip Steady
templates.description: Buy and hold a handful of the strongest Dow companies, selling only when a position deteriorates badly. Mirrors the buy-and-hold benchmark on our leaderboard.
templates.author: Agentic Trading Lab

pipeline.label: Trading instruction
pipeline.prompt: Buy and hold a handful of the strongest Dow companies. Sell only if a company's position deteriorates badly. Do not chase short-term moves.

templates.name: Even-Split Dow
templates.description: Spread the money evenly across all available Dow stocks and keep the split even. Mirrors the equal-weight benchmark on our leaderboard.
templates.author: Agentic Trading Lab

pipeline.label: Trading instruction
pipeline.prompt: Spread the money evenly across all available Dow stocks and keep the split even, rebalancing when any position drifts far from its equal share.

templates.name: A-Share Steady (T+1)
templates.description: A patient strategy for Chinese A-shares, built for that market's rule that shares bought today cannot be sold until the next trading day.
templates.author: Agentic Trading Lab

pipeline.label: Trading instruction
pipeline.prompt: Trade the available Chinese A-share stocks patiently. Because shares bought today cannot be sold until the next trading day, avoid quick in-and-out trades; build positions you are willing to hold overnight.
